cases.explain: Direct address in accusative case for the object of lamenting.

cases.translation: The day is near, the day of the Lord is near!
cases.explain: День is the subject of близок (is near), requiring nominative case.

cases.sentence: На Египет нагрянет меч. Куш охватит ___.
cases.translation: Sudan will be seized with anguish.
cases.explain: Direct object of охватит (will seize) takes accusative case.

cases.sentence: Разорены они будут среди разоренных ___ , города их будут стоять среди городов опустевших.
cases.translation: They will be desolate in the middle of the countries that are desolate.
cases.explain: The preposition среди (among) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Тогда узнают, что я Господь, когда я придам Египет ___.
cases.translation: Then they will know that I am the Lord when I set Egypt on fire.
cases.explain: The verb придам (I will give/hand over) takes dative for the recipient.

cases.sentence: В тот ___ мои вестники выйдут на кораблях.
cases.translation: In that day my messengers will go out in ships.
cases.explain: Temporal expressions with в (in) take accusative case.

cases.sentence: Я осушу рукава Нила и продам страну ___.
cases.translation: I will dry up the branches of the Nile and sell the land to evildoers.
cases.explain: The verb продам (I will sell) indicates transfer of possession, taking dative.

cases.sentence: Я подожгу Египет, скорчится в муках ___.
cases.translation: I will set fire to Egypt; Pelusium will be in great anguish.
cases.explain: Син is the subject of скорчится (will writhe), requiring nominative case.

reading.ru: Плачьте, о скорбный день! День близок, день Господа близок!
reading.question: What is coming, and what makes it a time of sorrow?
options: The day of the Lord is coming, bringing darkness
A day of rejoicing and celebration
A time of peace and prosperity
reading.correct: The day of the Lord is coming, bringing darkness
reading.explain: The text describes the approaching day of the Lord as a sorrowful, dark time.

reading.ru: На Египет нагрянет меч, Куш охватит ужас.
reading.question: What will happen to Egypt and Sudan?
options: The sword will come against Egypt, and anguish will seize Sudan
They will make a peace treaty
They will unite against their enemies
reading.correct: The sword will come against Egypt, and anguish will seize Sudan
reading.explain: The passage directly states that a sword will come upon Egypt and anguish will seize Sudan.

reading.ru: Разорены они будут среди разоренных земель, города их будут стоять среди городов опустевших.
reading.question: What will be the condition of Egypt's cities?
options: They will be desolate among desolate lands, empty among wasted cities
They will be filled with people
They will be rebuilt with gold
They will become prosperous trading centers
reading.correct: They will be desolate among desolate lands, empty among wasted cities
reading.explain: The text says the lands will be desolate and the cities will stand empty among devastated cities.

reading.ru: Я осушу рукава Нила и продам страну злодеям, рукой чужеземцев я опустошу землю.
reading.question: How will God judge the land of Egypt?
options: By drying the Nile, selling it to evildoers, and laying it waste by foreign hands
By granting it peace and security
By making it a garden of delight
reading.correct: By drying the Nile, selling it to evildoers, and laying it waste by foreign hands
reading.explain: God explicitly declares He will dry the Nile, sell the land to wicked people, and desolate it through foreigners.

reading.ru: Я рассею египтян среди других народов и развею их по чужим землям.
reading.question: What will happen to the people of Egypt?
options: They will be scattered among other nations and dispersed through foreign lands
They will gather in one place
They will become rulers of the world
They will establish a new empire
reading.correct: They will be scattered among other nations and dispersed through foreign lands
reading.explain: The passage directly states that God will scatter the Egyptians among nations and disperse them to foreign lands.

reading.ru: Тогда узнают, что я Господь, когда я придам Египет огню, и будут разбиты его помощники.
reading.question: What will demonstrate that God is the Lord?
options: He will set Egypt on fire and destroy its helpers
He will give Egypt great wealth
He will make Egypt the center of the world
reading.correct: He will set Egypt on fire and destroy its helpers
reading.explain: The passage states that through setting Egypt on fire and defeating its allies, God will prove He is the Lord.
